p: Conjunctive waw | Verb - Hifil - Conjunctive imperfect Cohortative - first person common singular

g.e: I will go to the right

d: to be right-handed or take the right-hand side
r: a primitive root; to be (physically) right (i.e. firm); but used only as denominative from H3225 (יָמִין) and transitive,
